# New Eastern Europe

> > A journal of analysis and commentary on Central and Eastern European politics, geopolitics, and society, covering Ukraine, Russia, Belarus, the South Caucasus, and the broader post-Soviet space.

New Eastern Europe provides in-depth analysis of political transitions, EU integration, conflicts, and cultural identity across the region. The publication features expert commentary on Ukraine-Russia relations, the Kremlin's influence, frozen conflicts like Transnistria and Nagorno-Karabakh, and democratic developments in countries from Poland to Azerbaijan.

## Key Topics

- Ukraine-Russia relations
- European Union integration
- Belarus political situation
- South Caucasus conflicts
- Nagorno-Karabakh
- Transnistria
- Putin and Kremlin politics
- Polish foreign policy
- Moldova geopolitics
- Azerbaijan and Armenia
- Post-Soviet transitions
- Democratic backsliding
- Eastern Partnership
- Regional security

## Ukraine: Politics and Geopolitics

- [Don't Write Off Ukraine](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/10/26/don-t-write-off-ukraine): Aleksander Kwaśniewski interview on EU-Ukraine relations and Tymoshenko
- [Ukraine - a buffer or a partner?](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/05/14/ukraine-a-buffer-or-a-partner): Analysis of Ukraine's strategic positioning between EU and Russia
- [Unravelling Ukraine](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/11/08/unravelling-ukraine): Regional analysis of Ukraine's geopolitics and Russia conflict
- [EURO 2012. Two Sides of the Same Coin](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2011/10/06/euro-2012-two-sides-of-the-same-coin): Analysis of EURO 2012 infrastructure impact on Poland and Ukraine

## Russia and Belarus: Authoritarian Politics

- [Russia's Badly Managed Democracy](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2011/12/07/russia-s-badly-managed-democracy): Andrew Wilson on 2011 Duma elections and Putin's managed democracy
- [And Then There Were None: The 2012 parliamentary elections in Belarus](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/10/22/and-then-there-were-none-the-2012-parliamentary-elections-in-belarus-2): Katerina Barushka on Belarus 2012 elections and opposition boycott
- [On Loans and Promises in Belarus](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/03/23/on-loans-and-promises-in-belarus): Alexander Chubrik analyzes Belarus economy, Russian loans, and WTO bid

## EU Integration and Regional Policy

- [Much Ado about Minsk, Too Little about Baku](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/05/07/much-ado-about-minsk-too-little-about-baku-2): EU policy comparison on human rights in Belarus and Azerbaijan
- [Is EU Membership the Only Option for Serbia?](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/06/11/is-eu-membership-the-only-option-for-serbia): Serbia's EU integration path and Kosovo independence challenges
- [It's Good to Have Neighbours](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/12/01/it-s-good-to-have-neighbours-2): Krakow conference on Polish foreign policy and bilateral relations

## South Caucasus and Frozen Conflicts

- [The Republic of Georgia – In the historical, contemporary and international context](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/05/18/the-republic-of-georgia-in-the-historical-contemporary-and-international-context): Georgia conference at Jagiellonian University covering 2008 war and history
- [Audit of International Actors' Policies Towards Moldova](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/11/29/audit-of-international-actors-policies-towards-moldova-2): Book review on Moldova's foreign policy and Transnistrian conflict
- [Andrew Wilson for New Eastern Europe on Moldova & Transistria](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/02/25/andrew-wilson-for-new-eastern-europe-on-moldova-transistria): Andrew Wilson on Moldova elections and Transnistria separatist region

## Culture and Historical Memory

- [A View Over a Lake](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/12/26/a-view-over-a-lake): David Chertow's family history from Tsarist Russia and Ukrainian shtetl
- [A View Over a Lake (Part 2)](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/12/26/a-view-over-a-lake-2): Personal narrative of Jewish emigration from Sokolivka shtetl in Ukraine
- [Identity Explored Onstage](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/02/08/identity-explored-onstage): Theatre review of Lesya Ukrainka's Forest Song at Lviv Kurbas Theatre

## Digital Diplomacy and Engagement

- [Engage in the Dialogue with New Eastern Europe](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/06/21/engage-in-the-dialogue-with-new-eastern-europe): Call for reader engagement via social media and newsletter subscription
- [Where Diplomacy Meets Marketing](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/12/05/where-diplomacy-meets-marketing-2): Igor Lyubashenko on e-diplomacy and digital communication strategies

## Optional

- [Dmitry Babich](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2011/11/14/dmitry-babich): Author profile of RIA Novosti journalist and political analyst
- [Polskie Radio dla zagranicy](https://neweasterneurope.eu/2012/04/03/polskie-radio-dla-zagranicy): Partner content featuring Polskie Radio international broadcasting
